metadata.name: squads_clear_signing
metadata.description: Clear-signing companion program for Squads Protocol v4 proposal approvals

instructions.name: verify_proposal
docs: Verify that the Squads v4 vault transaction stored on-chain matches
`args.instructions` exactly, and that this transaction contains the
matching Squads vote instruction (and nothing else). Aborts otherwise.

accounts.name: transaction
docs: The Squads v4 `VaultTransaction` account under vote.
the handler against the `(multisig, transaction_index)` in the args.

instructions.name: verify_buffer_hash
docs: Verify that a BPF upgradeable-loader Buffer account's program bytes
hash to `args.expected_hash` (SHA-256 via the native `sol_sha256`
syscall over the bytes with trailing zeros trimmed — byte-identical to
`solana-verify get-buffer-hash`).
Bundle it before `verify_proposal` + the Squads vote when the proposal
under approval is a program upgrade, so the offline signer sees the
exact build being deployed, not just the buffer's address. Aborts the
transaction on any mismatch.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: The BPF upgradeable-loader Buffer account whose contents are checked.

types.name: ExpectedAccountMeta
docs: Expected account meta of an inner instruction.

types.name: ExpectedInstruction
docs: One expected instruction inside the vault transaction, fully expanded
(indexes resolved to pubkeys) so an offline device can render it.

fields.name: program_id
docs: Program the instruction invokes.

fields.name: accounts
docs: Ordered account metas, exactly as compiled into the vault transaction.

fields.name: data
docs: Raw instruction data, byte-for-byte.

types.name: ProposalAction
docs: The kind of Squads v4 vote instruction expected next to `verify_proposal`.

types.name: VerifyBufferHashArgs
docs: Binds a buffer account to the exact build the offline signer reviewed.

fields.name: buffer
docs: The buffer account under verification (must equal the passed account —
duplicated here so the offline device renders it from the args alone).

fields.name: expected_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the buffer's program bytes with trailing zeros trimmed, as a
**lowercase hex string** (64 chars) — byte-identical to what
`solana-verify get-buffer-hash` prints, shown as-is to the signer so it
can be compared against a locally reproduced build.

types.name: VerifyProposalArgs
docs: Everything the offline signer needs to see, in one IDL-decodable blob.

fields.name: multisig
docs: The Squads v4 multisig this proposal belongs to.

fields.name: transaction_index
docs: Index of the vault transaction / proposal being voted on.

fields.name: vault_index
docs: Vault (authority) index the transaction executes under.

fields.name: num_ephemeral_signers
docs: Number of ephemeral signer PDAs the transaction uses (usually 0).

fields.name: member
docs: The multisig member casting the vote — must be the signer of the
sibling Squads vote instruction (i.e. the offline device's own key).

fields.name: action
docs: Which vote the sibling Squads instruction must be.

fields.name: instructions
docs: The complete, expanded instruction list of the vault transaction.
Must match the on-chain `VaultTransaction` exactly.
